stories.new_fact: AP reported the Trump administration removed more than 760,000 people from ACA marketplace coverage this year, suspended 850 brokers and agents, and claimed about $2.2 billion in savings tied to fraudulent or improper enrollments.
stories.new_takeaway: The coverage cleanup is useful only if appeal and reinstatement evidence shows eligible households are not being swept up with broker-created bad files.
stories.why_now: The AP reporting was published September 22 and changes the current marketplace operating risk.
stories.previous_coverage: No prior seven-episode coverage of ACA marketplace fraud cleanup; recent national stories covered grant disruptions, the Fed, voting access, ICE shooting and press access.
stories.uncertainty: Appeal and reinstatement rates, state-exchange complaints and insurer reports of coverage gaps are not yet disclosed.
stories.watch: CMS appeal and reinstatement data, state exchange complaints, insurer coverage-gap evidence, broker enforcement updates or a lawsuit over removals.

stories.new_fact: NBC4 reported Columbus leaders are advancing rules for e-bikes, scooters and similar devices, including enforcement around sidewalk and traffic behavior.
stories.new_takeaway: The local test is whether Columbus can reduce sidewalk conflict and dangerous riding without making short car-replacement trips impractical.
stories.why_now: The local proposal was reported September 22 and is moving through city action now.
stories.previous_coverage: No prior seven-episode coverage of Columbus micromobility enforcement; recent local stories covered schools, civic facilities, parkland, Grove City and reserves.
stories.uncertainty: Final ordinance language, citation schedule, campus/downtown enforcement plan and outreach design are not yet settled.
stories.watch: Final ordinance language, council vote, citation schedule, campus or downtown enforcement plan, delivery-worker exemption or backlash from mobility groups.

stories.new_fact: Fannie Mae announced mortgage-backed securities disclosure enhancements tied to loan characteristics investors use to price and monitor pools.
stories.new_takeaway: A disclosure change becomes a loan-delivery, data-quality, QC and aggregator-handoff issue before it becomes an investor-facing pool attribute.
stories.why_now: Fannie Mae's announcement was dated September 22, the day before the episode.
stories.previous_coverage: Recent lending segments covered Freddie UAD, Fannie multifamily documents, MI termination outreach, MGIC limits and VantageScore; none covered single-family MBS disclosure operations.
stories.uncertainty: Implementation details, investor reaction, aggregator instructions and lender delivery-file impacts need follow-up.
stories.watch: Implementation-date detail, lender-delivery instruction, investor response, aggregator bulletin, data-quality warning or Fannie clarification.

stories.new_fact: Deutsche Bank and Google Cloud disclosed a KYC document-review and risk-summary proof of concept for compliance analysts.
stories.new_takeaway: The useful bank-AI question is whether source traceability and measured analyst corrections can make KYC summaries auditable, not whether AI can draft a faster summary.
stories.why_now: The customer disclosure appeared September 22 and changes the banking-AI ledger.
stories.previous_coverage: Recent AI in Banking covered Danske/Mastercard payments, SocGen internal productivity, Ant International, Zopa and Goldman; KYC document intelligence has not been covered in the previous seven scripts.
stories.uncertainty: No live customer volume, error rate, false-negative rate, audit finding, analyst correction rate or production cost baseline was disclosed.
stories.watch: Production rollout, live volume, cycle-time baseline, analyst correction rate, false-negative or audit finding, regulator comment or named control design.
stories.ledger_row_changed: Added Deutsche Bank / Google Cloud KYC document review and risk-summary proof of concept; lane 4/8 document intelligence and compliance; pilot; evidence company claim; internal time-saving claim without live production metrics.

stories.new_fact: Alibaba Cloud laid out a full-stack AI roadmap covering Qwen models, agent tooling, cloud capacity and custom infrastructure.
stories.new_takeaway: The frontier issue is integrated model-cloud-chip economics and access, not a single model benchmark.
stories.why_now: Alibaba's primary announcement was dated September 23.
stories.previous_coverage: Recent frontier stories covered Grok 4.7, U.S.-China AI incident notification, slowdown litigation and Anthropic R&D metrics; no prior seven-episode Alibaba full-stack roadmap coverage.
stories.uncertainty: Benchmark, performance and cost claims remain company-reported until third-party workload replication and chip availability are verified.
stories.watch: Independent Qwen benchmark replication, chip availability detail, pricing or access change, enterprise customer metric or export-control response.
stories.frontier_bar: Infrastructure constraints plus price/access strategy; integrated model family, cloud capacity, custom silicon and enterprise-serving capability.

stories.new_fact: Market context continued to show a split between AI infrastructure enthusiasm and long-rate pressure.
stories.new_takeaway: A strong technology tape does not relieve borrowers, builders or capital-heavy firms unless long yields and MBS spreads improve.
stories.why_now: Market context was checked before drafting on September 23.
stories.previous_coverage: Markets are covered compactly each day; today's angle updates the financing-stress screen.
stories.uncertainty: Intraday prices and rate signals change through the session.
stories.watch: Whether long yields, MBS spreads and rate sheets improve rather than only AI-linked stocks.

stories.new_fact: The Columbus-area forecast called for showers likely, temperatures in the mid-60s and damp planning conditions.
stories.new_takeaway: The useful local weather advice is commute timing, rain gear and backup plans for fields, job sites and outdoor activity.
stories.why_now: Weather affects today's Columbus commute and planning.
stories.previous_coverage: Routine daily weather, not a repeated full story.
stories.uncertainty: Shower timing and local totals can change with later forecast updates.
stories.watch: Wet-road timing, heavier shower pockets and whether evening outdoor activity needs backup.
